analyst.summary: HFCL is a leading Indian optical fiber cable maker and telecom infrastructure provider, benefiting from 5G rollout and fiberization capex plus new export orders. The most recent quarter showed a genuine profit and margin improvement, but this follows several years of weak growth, and the balance sheet still shows real strain - negative free cash flow and slow-collecting receivables. We rate it a Hold: a promising recent inflection that needs more quarters to prove out before it changes the multi-year picture.
